plan_requirement.text: 三个场景在 Docker 路径下结果与子进程路径一致（峰值差 ≤ 1%）。

review_method: Read-only independent raw artifact, source byte/hash, configuration, process/exit/cleanup and Decimal peak comparison; no execution of target code or production comparator.
limitations: Reference is an independently supervised Python subprocess inside the same Docker isolation envelope, not a bare-host subprocess backend.
Capture/instrumentation, image, source/cache validation and clock protocol are shared; this is execution-path parity, not independent allocator instrumentation.
GPU before/initialization/end/after samples observed no sharing, but do not establish continuous exclusivity; no throughput claim.
s1 and HF Trainer genuinely OOM before their first optimizer update; both were configured for 20 updates and are not represented as 20-step successes.
HF Trainer uses synthetic tokens and a randomly initialized offline GPT-2 configuration; this run does not alone verify downloading or reusing external pretrained model weights.
Review hashes current implementation files for audit context; no independent before/after whole-runtime hash claim is made.
